title: Update Convex schema - add userId field to all user data tables
description: Add userId field (Better Auth user ID) to all 7 user data tables. Keep visitorId temporarily for migration. Add by_user indexes.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Add optional userId field to wordProgress table
Add optional userId field to userSongProgress table
Add optional userId field to lineProgress table
Add optional userId field to userWishlist table
Add optional userId field to userPracticeLog table
Add optional userId field to userGoals table
Add optional userId field to userPreferences table
Add by_user index to each table (userId)
Run npx convex dev to push schema

blockedBy: Convex dev command failed: Two output files share the same path but have different contents
notes:
Schema pattern for each table:

```typescript
wordProgress: defineTable({
  visitorId: v.string(),  // KEEP for migration
  userId: v.optional(v.string()),  // ADD - Better Auth user ID
  // ... other fields
})
  .index('by_visitor', ['visitorId'])  // KEEP for migration
  .index('by_user', ['userId'])  // ADD for secure queries
```

The userId field is the _id from Better Auth's user table, obtained via authComponent.safeGetAuthUser(ctx)._id

DO NOT remove visitorId yet - needed for migration in SEC-009.
